description: Domain registration only, for 1-10 domains, from the official RDAP registries. Use this when you need to spot newly registered (possibly risky) domains, check who a domain is registered with, or find upcoming expiries. The fastest and cheapest tool here; no DNS, email or website checks (use domain_report for everything). Input: domains (1-10 domains, URLs or email addresses). Returns results[] with, per domain: registration (registrar, created, updated and expiry dates, age in days, status codes), errors, analyzedAt and cached. Limits: each domain counts as one lookup; answers cached for 1 hour per domain; 25 free domains a day per IP without a key, more with a paid key in the x-api-key header. Read-only: nothing is stored, no email is sent.
